writeAPIKeyUse.reason: Flag off unchanged: the same SQL stamp (writeAPIKeyUseRows) and in-memory mirror (apiKeyUseMirror). Bounded, boundedWriteAPIKeyUse runs the stamp inside oauthMetadataTransaction and reads the stamped key and grant back into the installed image (the rows' once-a-minute/revoked predicates decide, as a reload); before this the installed image never saw lastUsedAt, so cold listings and later OAuth writes that re-marshal handed keys lost it. TestScaleP21M1APIKeyTelemetryDifferential compares exact canonical key/grant bytes for active and revoked records, selected-empty scope and oversized unrelated settings; TestScaleP21SW430OAuthColdRoutes compares the installed image with a reload after real Bearer authentication.
